description: The video starts with a talking head. At 1.15s, a black and blue graphic containing text and an image of a mosquito animates in from the top of the frame, taking up the top half of the screen. The talking head remains in the bottom half of the screen, resized. The graphic is fully in place by 1.5s. It remains on screen until 4.0s, when it quickly disappears from the frame.
description_orig: The video shows a split-screen with a news article about Google releasing mosquitoes on the top and the narrator on the bottom.

description: The first image of the shark appears at 7.91s, the second and third images of the bear and alligator appear at 8.44s and 8.91s respectively. These all leave the screen at around the same time.
description_orig: It shows a picture of a shark on the top half of the screen and the same person explaining in the bottom half.

description: The Debug logo (blue text on a white background, with 'a verily project' in smaller text) fades in and then a world map labeled 'Disease Spread Map' fades in.
description_orig: A screen showing 'Debug a verily project' is displayed.

description: The first frame shows a logo 'Debug' a Verily Project. The second frame presents a 'Disease Spread Map' with most of the landmasses being dark gray and some being light gray, with a border around it. The third and further frames all show laboratory set-ups, some of which are being operated by laboratory assistants. On the last frame (13.0s), two lab assistants are visible. All these frames are in black and white except 'Debug' logo, which is in blue.
description_orig: A black and white video of a person working with a microscope and some lab equipment is shown.

description: The word 'MOSQUIT' with a magnified mosquito graphic comes into view. Below it, the words 'ONE OF THE WORLD'S DEADLIEST ANIMALS' appear.
description_orig: The text 'MOSQUITOES' with a magnifying glass over it is displayed.

description: The motion graphic begins with a stylized magnify glass effect. Text appears, revealing a mosquito inside the magnify glass. The graphic then transitions to a dark screen with a small, stylized insect before large text 'GOOD BUGS' appears with a small insect on top of the 'O' in 'GOOD'.
description_orig: A small animated image of a mosquito flies into the center of a black screen.

description: The graphic says “GOOD BUGS” in capital letters, with a small black bug icon in the middle, sitting within a large light blue circle. Below the main text, there is a black banner that changes text from 'GOOD' to 'MOSQUITOES', and then to 'BASICALLY', 'THESE GOOD', 'MOSQUITOES', and 'ARE ALL'. The bug icon then changed to a male mosquito labeled as such.
description_orig: An illustration of a mosquito with a blue circle around its body is shown.

description: The infographic begins with a small illustration of a mosquito, followed by a magnified image labeled 'Wolbachia,' which is a natural bacteria found in many insects. Text appears at the bottom explaining each visual. The Wolbachia image zooms out and transitions back to the mosquito illustration as the description completes.
description_orig: The screen shows a magnified image of Wolbachia bacteria.

description: It shows Wolbachia written, followed by found in and many insects. It demonstrates a blue-colored insect mating with a red-colored insect causing the eggs to not hatch. It repeats the process of mating the blue and red insects leading to a decrease in the red population. After this is done, it describes 'Google is'
description_orig: The video displays animations of blue and red circles representing mosquitoes mating and then showing a grid of red and blue dots, with the blue dots gradually disappearing.

description: The infographic depicts a sorting algorithm for mosquitoes. It shows a device with a gate that separates male mosquitoes (represented by red glow on one side) from female mosquitoes (represented by yellow glow on the other side). Then, a robot-like machine is shown raising mosquitoes, followed by a depiction of a tracking system that sorts mosquitoes based on sex, with females entering a chamber on the left and males being released from a spout on the right. Throughout the animation, text overlays specific words related to the process, such as 'ALGORITHM', 'SORTING', 'THE MALES', 'FEMALES', 'ROBOTS', 'RAISING THE MOSQUITOES', 'AND SOFTWARE', 'TRACKING MOSQUITOES', and 'SHOULD BE RELEASED'.
description_orig: The video displays a series of illustrated machines for sorting, raising, and tracking mosquitoes based on sex.

description: A screenshot of text appears on the top half of the screen, with overlaid text boxes animating from the center bottom up, highlighting key phrases like 'HAS HELPED', 'CUT DENGUE', 'RISK BY', and 'OVER 70%'. The underlying text mentions project Wolbachia in Singapore and reduction in dengue.
description_orig: Screenshots of text about Debug and Project Wolbachia are displayed, followed by a video clip of mosquitoes.

description: It's the headline of a Hindustan Times article related to ICMR's call for more studies on a plan to use mosquitos. The text scrolls into view from the top of the image to about the mid-point. The headline is highlighted in yellow.
description_orig: A screenshot of a Hindustan Times article with the headline 'ICMR calls for more studies on plan to use bugged mosquitoes' is displayed.
